excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, long black hair, Asian ethnicity. Wears a yellow tee shirt with a unicorn image worn UNDER a white lab coat, yellow skirt and white sneakers.
excavation_context.stage: Pneumatic Air-Scribing a Heavy Ornithopod Block

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_6, wearing her white lab coat and unicorn shirt, sits at her laboratory bench under focused spotlights guiding a vibrating pneumatic air-scribe tool. Under her guidance, bright red variegated mudstone matrix breaks apart to uncover the long, robust caudal vertebrae of a Tenontosaurus tail. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
